scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tol colorblind-safe palette and thoughtful marginal box plot show real design intent, but the percentile labels (P25/P50/P75/P90) overlap directly with the subtitle text at the top, and the rightmost callout label ('Sam Q.') is clipped at the viewport edge — two concrete layout bugs that cap the score.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is appropriate and honest for right-skewed income data; circles use fixed radius (no area encoding misuse); percentile lines and box plot quartiles are fully data-driven; main robustness weakness is the hardcoded xScale domain [14000,550000] which would clip or misplace points if data shifted significantly.
scores.stress_test_note: No brush/zoom/transitions — mostly static; tooltip pointermove reads offsetWidth on every move (forced reflow, unthrottled), but no brush storms, infinite loops, stale closures, transition races, or mouse-touch fights; pointer events API correctly unifies input.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four-category colorblind-safe palette, pre-computed swarm (no live animation), and a clean marginal box plot keep cognitive load low; the five top-earner callout labels cluster and slightly overlap in the upper-right corner, creating minor label confusion but not meaningfully undermining readability.
